title: Have You Ever Been to Almaty?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Kamila, have you ever been to Almaty?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Yes — I've been there three times. I grew up in a suburb nearby actually.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Oh, I didn't know that! Have you been back recently?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: I went last summer — June. I stayed with my grandmother for two weeks.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I've never been there. I've always wanted to go but never had the chance.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: You should go. Have you ever eaten at a proper Almaty café? The food scene has changed a lot.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: No, I haven't. The furthest south I've been is Shymkent.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Have you enjoyed Shymkent? I've heard it's warmer and friendlier than Almaty.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I went there in 2021, for a volleyball tournament with Zhibek. We stayed for four days.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: They came second. She was disappointed but she's already qualified for another one.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: I've never watched a live volleyball match. Have you seen many?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Dozens. I've been to every home match this semester. It's incredible to watch Zhibek play.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Has she always been so focused? Even when she was younger?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I've known her since secondary school. She's been the same since day one. Total commitment.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: That's rare. I've changed what I want to do about five times since I arrived at WKU.

questions.text: "Have you ever been to Almaty?" — What tense is this?
questions.hint: "Have you ever been...?" = Present Perfect question about life experience (ever/never).

questions.text: "I went there in 2021." — Why does Rustam use Past Simple, not PP?
opts: Because there's a specific past time (2021)
questions.correct: Because there's a specific past time (2021)
questions.hint: Specific past time (2021, last June, yesterday) → Past Simple. No time or "ever/never" → Present Perfect.

questions.text: "I ___ (know) her since secondary school." Use Present Perfect.
questions.hint: "I've known her since secondary school." — "since" + PP: "know → have known".

questions.text: "I've been there three times." — What does "been" mean here?
questions.hint: "have been to" = visited (and returned). "have gone to" = went and is still there now.

questions.text: "I went last summer." Past Simple because:
questions.hint: "Last summer / in 2021 / yesterday" = specific past time → Past Simple.

questions.text: "Have you ever been to Almaty? — Yes, I went there in June." is correct.
questions.hint: First sentence: PP (ever/life experience). Second: PS (specific time: "in June"). Both correct! ✅

questions.text: "She ___ (be) to every home match this semester." Use Present Perfect.
questions.hint: "She's been to every home match." (been to = visited/attended) — Present Perfect.

questions.text: "I've never been to Almaty." — What does "never" show here?
questions.hint: "I've never been to..." = 0% experience in my entire life. "never" + PP = no experience ever.
